caps_and_exclusions: Housing excluded; cash advances, gift/prepaid cards, P2P, tax payments other than eligible housing tax, gambling and fees excluded.

Housing-only option earns 0.5x / 0.75x / 1x / 1.25x at everyday-to-housing spend ratios >=25% / >=50% / >=75% / >=100%, respectively; below 25% receives 250 points per billing cycle. Pre-2027 accounts can alternatively select Flexible Bilt Cash: 4% Bilt Cash on everyday purchases and redeem $3 Cash per 100 housing points, maximum 1x housing; choosing Flex excludes the housing tiers.

eligibility: Eligible residential housing via Bilt; good standing; linked bank account; card account opening date and legacy election control future options.
